module-2.v3_agent-03._notes: V4 model: yr = v * (delta - delta_off - c3 * delta^3) / (L + K_us * v^2) + tau * d(delta)/dt + bias. Fitted per-platform with L-BFGS-B on yaw RMSE objective (route-grouped 80/20 train-dev split). Tesla deliberately set to all-zeros for V0 passthrough since the platform's truth column IS the V0 KS output (no independent measurement).
